snapshotSaveFailed: The recovery snapshot could not be written or verified. Visible content was not replaced and existing recovery data is unchanged.
manifestSaveFailed: The lock manifest could not be committed. Visible content was not replaced and existing recovery data is unchanged.
placeholderSnapshotRejected: Locked placeholder content was detected. The new snapshot was rejected and all previous recovery data was kept. Fully unlock first.
storageCorrupt: The recovery manifest is damaged. Security Lock stopped to avoid overwriting data. Keep the workspace and restore from a backup.
setPasswordHint: You may use a non-empty password of any length. This encrypts the current document and all child documents. Save the recovery code shown next.
removeLockConfirm: This permanently removes the lock after restoring and verifying every protected document. Enter the password or recovery code next.
notUnlocked: Restore all protected documents before removing the lock
recoveryUnlockFailed: Failed to unlock with recovery code
recoveryCodeHint: Use this code to unlock if you forget the password. Keep it in a safe place.
recoveryCodeSaved: I saved the recovery code in a safe place
encryptedPlaceholder: This document has a security lock. Unlock it to view the content.
operationInProgress: Another lock operation is already in progress
overlappingLock: This document overlaps an existing locked folder
partialRollback: The operation failed and some documents could not be rolled back. Keep the recovery code and retry unlocking
decryptFailed: Encrypted data is incomplete; the lock record was kept
